## Download

- **GameModeTray.exe**: the app, a single file with nothing to install. It needs the
  [.NET 10 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/10.0) (or later);
  if it is missing, Windows shows a message with the link to download it when the app starts.
- **SHA256SUMS.txt**: checksum of the exe.

Windows 10 version 2004 or later, 64-bit, with Bluetooth. See the
[README](https://github.com/wergio/GameModeTray#readme) for the supported headphones and how
to add others.
